assumptions: This is a completed working derivation with no separate completed internal audit asserted. K includes controller, monitor and clock configurations. The 95-state rare example is calculated, not a run; an ordinary absorbing chain gives the same answer.

provides: A finite autonomous homogeneous controller with fixed support and K total states has terminal conditional TV at most tanh(Delta/4), hence at most tanh[K/4 log((1+alpha)/(1-alpha))] under the stated row likelihood perturbation. Forest normalization cancels rare-event probability and waiting time. Independent reset/row-access and a positive transition floor support a separately paid finite calibration procedure.
